name: Ryouki no Ori -Saishuu Shobun no Heya-
original_name: 猟奇の檻 最終処分の部屋
source:
The girls sit afraid making so much as a sound, as the ominous figure in black grips a sinister weapon.  
Screams and death cries; an endless chorus in this blood-soaked place.  
Girls tremble in terror, anxiously waiting for their turn.
 
“I’ll do anything, use my body, please, please, make me cum!” 
“I beg you, fuck me… make it hurt as much as possible…” 

“…Alright, it’s your turn now. Let’s see how well you entertain me!”

[Translated from [url=https://www.digiket.com/work/show/_data/ID=ITM0038491/]the digiket[/url]]
translation:
当那个不祥的黑衣人握着一把邪恶的武器时，女孩们害怕地坐着，发出声音。
尖叫声和死亡的哭声；在这个血淋淋的地方，无尽的合唱。
女孩们惊恐得浑身发抖，焦急地等待着轮到自己。
 
“我会做任何事情，用我的身体，拜托，拜托，让我射精！” 
“我求求你，操我……让它尽可能地受伤……” 

“……好了，现在轮到你了，看你能逗我玩多少！”
